title_sq: Shesim apartament 2+1 tek Ish Fusha e Aviacionit
description_sq:
Ju ofrojme per shitje apartament 2+1 ne zonen e Ish Fushes se Aviacionit!
Spacifikat e prones:
-Kati 5 banim
-Ndertim me ashensor
-Siperfaqe netto 72.5 m2
-Siperfaqe bruto 81.0 m2
-Orientim Veri-Perendim
-Me dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor
Apartamenti ka organizim ne sallon, koridor shperndares, 2 dhoma gjumi, tualet me dritare dhe ballkon.
Ofrohet dhe mundesia per blerje me kredi.
Ne apartament jane bere investime ne parket te ri dhe cilesor, dyer te reja, linje elektrike e re, patinim dhe lyerje e mureve.
Zona ofron facilitet per nje jetese komode dhe te shendetshme.
Per te tjera detaje me kontaktoni!
title_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment at the former Aviation Field
description_en: We offer for sale a 2+1 apartment in the area of ​​the former Aviation Field! Property specifications: - 5th residential floor - Building with elevator - Net area 72.5 m2 - Gross area 81.0 m2 - Orientation North-West - With regular mortgage documentation The apartment is organized in a living room, distribution corridor, 2 bedrooms, bathroom with window and balcony. It is also possible to purchase on credit. In the apartment, investments were made in new and high-quality parquet, new doors, new electric line, patination and painting of the walls. The area offers facilities for a comfortable and healthy life. For other details contact me!
